product_family: Taskade is an AI-native workspace platform ("Taskade Genesis") combining real-time collaborative docs/tasks, AI agents, and no-code automation workflows, sold in Free/Pro/Business consumer-team tiers plus a separate Enterprise tier with SSO/SCIM/DPA.

privacy.ai_training_note: Taskade's own privacy policy states: 'We do not use or access your data for developing, improving, or training generalized or non-personalized AI and/or machine learning models.' For third-party AI providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google) used within the product, Taskade states it contractually prohibits them from training general models on customer data but discloses it 'cannot guarantee third-party compliance and disclaim liability for provider practices beyond our reasonable control.' No tier-based contradiction found between the security page and privacy policy on this point.
privacy.data_region: Primary infrastructure hosted on Amazon AWS in the US East region, with Cloudflare for content delivery; enterprise customers may be offered data residency preferences (specific alternate regions not disclosed).

security.name: Encryption at rest
security.value: Automated backups encrypted with AES-256; automation credentials stored in an encrypted vault (AES-256)

security.name: Encryption in transit
security.value: Encrypted connections with SSL/TLS certificate validation; message-level encryption for document synchronization

security.name: SSO / Identity
security.value: SAML 2.0 SSO integration, OAuth 2.0 and JWT token validation, multi-factor authentication (MFA) enforcement, SCIM 2.0 user provisioning

security.name: Monitoring
security.value: 24/7 SOC monitoring; immutable audit logs with tamper detection

security.name: Access control
security.value: Row-level security (RLS) policies; unique network system authentication enforced; remote access encrypted; network firewalls utilized

security.name: Endpoint/org security
security.value: MDM system utilized; control self-assessments conducted

products.name: Taskade Workspace (Free / Pro / Business)
products.category: Team collaboration, project/task management, real-time docs
products.data_scope: Team workspace content, tasks, documents, chat; standard AWS US-East hosting
products.notes: Core consumer/SMB product; no SSO/SCIM/DPA at these tiers per vendor security page.

products.name: Taskade Genesis / AI Agents & Workflows
products.category: AI agent builder, no-code automation (CRMs, dashboards, portals)
products.data_scope: Workspace data plus prompts/content passed to third-party model providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google) for inference
products.notes: Taskade states it does not train its own models on customer data and contractually restricts third-party model providers from training on it, but cannot guarantee third-party compliance.

products.name: Taskade Enterprise
products.data_scope: Same workspace data model with added identity and compliance controls
products.notes: Adds SAML SSO, SCIM provisioning, MFA enforcement, and Data Processing Agreements; enterprise customers may get data residency preferences. This is the tier most relevant for compliance-conscious buyers.

compare.pricing_model: Freemium SaaS (Free / Pro / Business / Enterprise tiers), subscription-based
compare.data_residency: US East (AWS) primary; enterprise data residency preferences available but not itemized publicly

flags: Vendor's own security page discloses SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, GDPR, and CCPA are all 'in progress', not yet certified as of this review.
No independent (non-vendor) confirmation of any cert status was found; the compliance information available relies entirely on Taskade's own trust center and security page self-attestation.
HIPAA is not addressed at all; no BAA offering was found.

Third-party AI model providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google) are used for inference; Taskade's no-training guarantee for these providers is contractual, not independently verified, and vendor itself disclaims liability for third-party non-compliance.

Trust center (trust.taskade.com) is a lightly-populated SafeBase-style page with most substantive detail redirecting to www.taskade.com/security; some trust center sections (Resources, Media) were sparse.
